dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (III)
dialogues.text: "...who live in Chenyu, whose hearts are on the mountains, who wander in time and world alike..."

dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (III)
dialogues.text: "...Who in the valley depths knows of the heavens? I think upon your beauty and weep..."

dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (III)
dialogues.text: "...The years have passed. Frost and dew weather my garments. Upon this wall shall I paint, that it may be lasting testament..."
